{{Top}}
[[File:Hobbie-TESB40.png|thumb|right|250px|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian flew as Rogue Four during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].]]
'''Rogue Four''' was the callsign used by certain fighter pilots of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].

The pilots who have used the callsign include:
*[[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] ([[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]])<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
*[[Xarcce Huwla]] ([[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]])<ref name="XWRS:MR">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref>
*[[Bror Jace]] ([[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]])<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
*[[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] (6.5 ABY)<ref name="XW:WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>
*[[Erisi Dlarit]] ([[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]])<ref name="XW:TKT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>
*[[Riv Shiel]] (7 ABY)<ref name="XW:TBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
*Derek Klivian (7&ndash;[[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]])<ref name="XW:SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref><ref name="XW:IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
